youtube.aciklama: Repair strategies are divided into general and specific. General requests such as pardon or what do not tell the speaker what was missed; the speaker often just repeats the same sentence louder. In a specific request the person says what was not understood; for example, 'I missed the time, could you repeat it?' tells the speaker right away what is missing.
